$comment: THE CALL BANDS' CENSUS, docs/33 DC-13 and DECISIONS.md § D1440 to § D1444 (wave AO lane DR-2, swarm DR's Q2 and Q3). For every week order a tower deals from week 2 (shift/weekOrders.ts#dealtWeekOrdersOf), under each of the two profiles DC-11 shows holding that order's week on the most crowds (shift/weekDominance.ts#bandedProfilesOf), the careful line (that profile at the brief, keep who drives, the protocol's placement answer) played through the shipped call session on the protocol's census crowds (indexes into data/week-way.json's held-out list), Monday to Friday. One entry per raised who-drives call: its crowd, its weekday, its instant in simulated seconds, the two switch targets the card offered, and a mark per answer and per offer candidate the card did not offer, each run from the call with every earlier press kept and nothing pressed after, graded with the day's goals: C cleared, m missed (any goal not met). dayMarks is the careful line's own day verdict per crowd, Monday to Friday. Nothing derived is stored: the keep band, the switch floor, the answer ceiling, the offer list and the week sheet's DC-13 line are arithmetic in shift/callBands.ts. PROVENANCE: every mark is a measurement, run by `CALL_BANDS_SWEEP=1 CALL_BANDS_OUT=<file> npx vitest run --project viz --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=36000000 packages/viz/src/everyday/callBands.sweep.test.ts` (or one profile at a time with CALL_BANDS_PROFILES) and copied row for row; the nightly call-bands job requires the rows to be exactly these. The protocol's shares and the candidates' order are CHOSEN, an agent's proposal for the owner: the band of a fifth to three fifths, the floor of one in five and the ceiling of two thirds are the swarm's, and Capacity aware stands where Energy aware stood, the ruling's first candidate for that place. SINCE DECISIONS.md § D1616 no authored order is dealt on Midtown from week 2 (the week census on the engine § D1603 fixed refuses two days of midtown-early-lift, and a pre-registered re-author search found no replacement), so this census has no row: the command above, run on that tree, measures none, and the offer list is the protocol's candidates in order.
